vikisozluk.baslik: سَأَفَ • (saʔafa) I (non-past يَسْأَفُ (yasʔafu), verbal noun سَأْف (saʔf))
anlam: to be rent, to be pared, to be chapped, to be affected by fissures, to have fibres or rind or keratin divided

vikisozluk.baslik: (obsolete)
anlam: bristles, hair at the end of the tail of a wolf

vikisozluk_etimolojiler.metin: See سَعَف (saʕaf, “palm branches having leaves”), as سَأَف (saʔaf) is glossed the opposite, “palm branches stripped of leaves”.
